title: Figma Plugin Phase 11 - Comprehensive Hardcoded Values Elimination
overview: Systematically eliminate ALL remaining hardcoded CSS-derived values in Figma generators by using themeData from theme-data.json or registry.styling. This phase addresses 100+ hardcoded values across 15+ generator files identified in audit.

context.problem: Multiple generator files contain hardcoded numeric values (fontSize, padding, borderRadius, gap, width, height) that should derive from theme-data.json or component-registry.json. When CSS/Tailwind changes, these values drift and Figma output becomes incorrect.
context.current_state: Phase 10 complete. Tabs and Toast read from registry. But audit found ~100+ hardcoded values in: empty.ts, meter.ts, combobox.ts, layer-card.ts, dropdown.ts, switch.ts, pagination.ts, menubar.ts, surface.ts, input-area.ts, collapsible.ts, dialog.ts, code-block.ts, select.ts, date-range-picker.ts

existing_infrastructure.theme_data_json: packages/kumo/scripts/figma/plugin/generated/theme-data.json - Contains computed spacing, fontSize, fontWeight, borderRadius, shadows from CSS
existing_infrastructure.shared_ts_imports: SPACING, BORDER_RADIUS, FONT_SIZE, FALLBACK_VALUES already import from themeData - generators should use these
existing_infrastructure.registry_styling: Some components have registry.components.X.styling with dimensions - already used by date-range-picker.ts pattern

categories_of_hardcoded_values.font_sizes: fontSize: 12/14/16/24 should use FONT_SIZE.xs/sm/base/lg or themeData.tailwind.fontSize['2xl']
categories_of_hardcoded_values.component_dimensions: width/height values specific to components - should be in registry.styling or FALLBACK config with comment

primary: Replace ALL hardcoded fontSize values with FONT_SIZE.* or themeData references
Replace ALL hardcoded spacing/padding/gap with themeData.tailwind.spacing.scale references
Replace ALL hardcoded borderRadius with BORDER_RADIUS.* references
Document remaining intentional hardcoded values with FIGMA-SPECIFIC comments
Add drift detection tests for high-risk generators
metrics: All generators import themeData or use shared.ts constants
Drift detection tests for critical generators
